# synthetic: concatenation of constants and a placeholder clause
LOCK = " FOR UPDATE"


def fine(db, pid):
    q = "SELECT id FROM item WHERE a = ?"
    if pid is not None:
        q = q + " AND pid = ?"
    db.fetchall(q + " ORDER BY id", (1,))
    db.fetchall("SELECT id FROM item WHERE id = ?" + LOCK, (1,))
